question: Should OpenClaw formally document `capabilities/*.md` as an optional workspace inventory convention, or should discovery remain limited to existing `TOOLS.md`, workspace-skill, plugin, and ClawHub guidance?
rationale: The branch is mechanically narrow and does not add runtime behavior, but whether a new public workspace convention belongs in core documentation is a product and support-boundary choice that source review cannot resolve.

options.title: Adopt the narrow inventory convention
options.body: Merge the docs-only pattern with its stated limits: intentional `TOOLS.md` linking, no automatic bootstrap loading, and skills/plugins remaining authoritative.

options.title: Keep existing discovery guidance only
options.body: Decline this new convention and direct advanced workspaces to existing `TOOLS.md`, workspace skills, plugins, and ClawHub documentation instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow inventory convention
recommendation.body: Merge the docs-only pattern with its stated limits: intentional `TOOLS.md` linking, no automatic bootstrap loading, and skills/plugins remaining authoritative.
